[LNAM.7.1] **Schema names on the wire.** A schema's own name ([LIMP.13.1]) crosses the `FactAssert` wire
(`FactAssert.schema_name`, [RFCS.6]) and both tiers decode a fact body against the schema,
so a producer and consumer must share the NFC-normalized name, each segment of a
library's path included. The compiler must emit
NFC; the runtime must not re-normalize (it compares the bytes).
